annotations.text:
Categories become a FILTER, not headings you scroll past.
Presets (packs) stay separate, above.
Sub-filters by provider appear only for categories that have them.
Logos are placeholder monograms — real marks get sourced from each vendor.

A — Rail
All 9 categories visible at once, no horizontal scroll, counts always readable.
Costs 216px of grid width: 3 cards per row instead of 4.

B — Tabs
Full width for the grid: 4 cards per row.
But 9 tabs scroll horizontally on smaller screens, and the far ones get hidden.
